# Simplesat

Simplesat captures customer feedback and CSAT scores through surveys, integrating directly with helpdesk systems for real-time performance insights

Category: Sales & CRM. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/simplesat/.

## Actions

- **Create or Update Customer**: This tool creates or updates a customer in simplesat.
- **Create or Update Team Member**: This tool creates a new team member or updates an existing one if a team member with the same email address is found.
